target.statement: SPORE achieves ARI = 0.98 on the Compound dataset (399 points, 2D), the best among all evaluated methods.

compute.basis: Compound is a tiny 399-point 2D dataset; the paper's own runtime table shows SPORE taking 0.03 s, and the full hyperparameter search (50 configs) plus 10 reruns on a single CPU core would take well under a minute, so the 10-minute estimate is dominated by pip install and data download.

title: SPORE: Skeleton Propagation Over Recalibrating Expansions
